description: Shared data-loading foundation plus Deliverable 1 (energy consumption statistics). Creates the src/backend/ package with reusable, pure loaders/helpers used by all three deliverables, then builds data/build/consumption_stats.json from RECS 2020 + EIA-861M, keeping the two populations separate per ground-truth's rule. FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on this feature's loaders, so it MUST land first.
steps: Create the package: src/backend/__init__.py (empty) and src/backend/data_sources.py. All functions pure, no file writes.

In data_sources.py add loaders reading data/snapshot/: load_recs() -> list/DataFrame of rows with KWH, TOTSQFT_EN, YEARMADERANGE, FUELHEAT, TYPEHUQ, NWEIGHT (floats); load_eia() -> rows with year, month, status, sales_mwh, customers, kwh_per_customer; load_fixed_rates() -> parsed 22-yr basic-service fixed-rate table from fixed_residential_cents_2026-07-02.csv.

Add weighted_percentile(values, weights, p) generalizing reference/verify_usage.py `wmed` (sort by value, cumulative weight crossing p*sumW). Add seasonal_shares() that recomputes the 12 shares EXACTLY as verify_usage.py does (per-year sales share, mean over calendar years 2019-2025) and returns them full-precision normalized to sum to 1.0. Add typical_account_2025() returning annual 7135 and the 12-month vector (sales*1000 / 12-month trailing mean customers).

Create src/backend/stats_consumption.py with pure functions: home_like_yours_stats() (NWEIGHT-weighted annual-kWh mean + P10/P50/P90, plus unweighted median/mean cross-checks; weighted P50 by sqft bucket {<1000,1000-1999,2000-2999,3000+} and by FUELHEAT {gas=1,oil=3,electricity=5,propane=2,wood=7} with P10/P90 bands; 12 monthly bands = annual.pX * seasonal_share[m]) and typical_account_stats() (from EIA).

Create src/backend/build_stats.py entrypoint that assembles the JSON shape from data/build/.plan/backend-stats-plan.md (keys: generated, sources, homeLikeYours{annualKwh, monthlyKwh[12], bySqftBucket, byHeatFuel}, typicalAccount{annualKwh, monthlyKwh[12], note}, seasonalShares[12], seasonalSharesSum) and writes data/build/consumption_stats.json (create data/build/ if absent). Print a one-line summary.

Create tests/backend/test_data_sources.py and tests/backend/test_consumption_stats.py covering tests 1-3 from the plan: band ordering p10<=p50<=p90 for annual and all 12 months; seasonal shares sum to 1.0 +/-0.001 and each 4-dp share equals the ground-truth anchor; weighted sqft-bucket medians == {4074,5974,7270,10597}; fuel medians == {gas 5616, oil 8148, elec 6092, propane 7255, wood 7270}; unweighted median annual == 6649, mean == 7868; typical annual == 7135 with the 12-month vector matching ground truth; written JSON round-trips and has the required top-level keys.
acceptance_criteria: Running `python3 src/backend/build_stats.py` creates/overwrites data/build/consumption_stats.json with no error and prints a summary line.
Running `python3 -m pytest tests/backend/test_data_sources.py tests/backend/test_consumption_stats.py -q` passes all tests.

consumption_stats.json seasonalShares sum to 1.0 within 0.001 and the 4-dp-rounded values equal the ground-truth seasonal vector; the weighted sqft/fuel medians and the typical-account numbers equal ground-truth.md.
No files under reference/ were modified; no new pip dependency was added.
findings: Shared foundation landed; FEAT-002/003 import from src.backend.data_sources. Public API (all pure, no file writes): load_recs(path=RECS_PATH)->list[dict] with float KWH/TOTSQFT_EN/YEARMADERANGE/FUELHEAT/TYPEHUQ/NWEIGHT (552 rows); load_eia(path=EIA_PATH)->list[dict] with int year/month/customers, str status, float sales_mwh/kwh_per_customer (200 rows); load_fixed_rates(path=FIXED_RATES_PATH)->list[(term_end_year,term_end_month,{util_id:cents|None})] newest-first, value on term's LAST month (rows[0] is term_end 2027-01: {NG:17.185,EV_EAST:17.323,EV_WEST:15.934,UNITIL:18.921}); weighted_percentile(values,weights,p in [0,1]) generalizes verify_usage wmed (p=0.5), fails closed on empty/mismatched/non-positive-weight/out-of-range; seasonal_shares(eia_rows=None,years=range(2019,2026))->12 floats normalized to sum 1.0 (4dp == ground-truth anchor); typical_account_2025(eia_rows=None,year=2025)->(annual=7135, [687,652,566,527,483,554,791,710,542,497,459,667]). Column->UtilityId map exposed as data_sources.UTIL_IDS {NG:NG,NSTAR:EV_EAST,WMECo:EV_WEST,Unitil:UNITIL}. Ground-truth anchor constants exposed: GROUND_TRUTH_SHARES, GROUND_TRUTH_TYPICAL_MONTHLY, GROUND_TRUTH_TYPICAL_ANNUAL. Snapshot path constants: RECS_PATH/EIA_PATH/FIXED_RATES_PATH. stats_consumption.FUEL_CODES={gas:1,oil:3,electricity:5,propane:2,wood:7}; home_like_yours_stats returns annualKwh.mean=NWEIGHT-weighted mean (7237.0), plus unweightedMedian(6649)/unweightedMean(7868) cross-checks (NOTE: plan example JSON showed 7868.0 for 'mean' but the step spec requires the WEIGHTED mean there; weighted P50=5990.09 which is below the unweighted median 6649 as expected for a right-skewed weighted dist). Import convention matches the hmm sibling: tests insert repo root into sys.path then 'from src.backend...'; no src/__init__.py or conftest needed. build entrypoints expose build_payload()+build_artifact(out_path)+main(); build_artifact writes sorted-keys indent=2 + trailing newline. data/build/ created. Did NOT touch reference/*; no new pip deps. Term-span 'previous end + 1 month' rule from ingest_rates.derive_terms is NOT yet implemented as a helper here (FEAT-002 savings needs it) — add term_spans() in data_sources when FEAT-002 lands, or derive in savings_model.
